text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening paragraph","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents a focused claim and maintains a recognizable argumentative structure from introduction through conclusion."},{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"paragraph development","description":"Each main point is developed in its own paragraph, which helps the writing feel more controlled and easier to follow."},{"evidence":"repeated reasons with explanations","quality":"support and elaboration","description":"The essay gives several reasons for its opinion and usually adds explanation rather than only stating a claim."},{"evidence":"links like \"Although,\" \"Not only,\" and \"Because of\"","quality":"cohesive transitions","description":"The writing uses a range of transitional phrases to connect ideas and show how points relate to one another."},{"evidence":"\"teachers and students are volunteering\" / \"students aren't the only ones\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The sentences are generally more complete and stable, with fewer disruptive errors that block comprehension."},{"evidence":"academic phrasing such as \"benefits,\" \"independent adults,\" and \"extra help\"","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay uses more formal and topic-appropriate vocabulary to express ideas precisely."},{"evidence":"\"There are different ways that a person learns best\"","quality":"idea clarity","description":"The essay communicates its ideas in a clearer, more logically connected way than the other response."}]}
